_comment: The knowledge base. Retrieval is keyword overlap between the utterance (plus the agent's own tags) and each fact's tags -- deliberately dumb and deliberately visible: every response reports which fact indices it injected, so you can watch retrieval work or fail to. It is NOT embeddings and NOT a graph. Upgrading it means replacing one proc (agents.retrieve).
_history: EscapeFromMyBasement called this an 'aoughwl ontology / belief-graph service'. In the code it was one 3.1 KB Python file with a 9-entry hardcoded persona dict, a substring match, and an in-RAM event list wiped on process exit. There was no graph and no ontology to port. What is ported is the pattern: retrieve, inject, remember.

facts.text: Extracts open and close on a timer; some need a green flare, a car battery, or a squad mate to hold them.
Factory has gate 0, gate 3, the cellars and the med tent camera; gate 3 wants no armoured rig.
Bitcoin, LEDX, graphics cards and Tetriz keep their value; most of what you find does not.
Scavs will not open on another scav unless you point a weapon or run at them.
Tagilla walks Factory with a sledgehammer and a welding mask and does not use cover.
Reshala holds Dorms on Customs with four guards and does not push alone.
Radio traffic carries as far as the set does; past that there is only hiss.
Ask me for status, for what is on a channel, or to remember something for you.
Engine status is at /aowlspt/voice/status; it lists every path each engine resolved and whether the file is there.
A heavy bleed kills faster than the pain does; the tourniquet goes on before the painkiller.
